name: Iris Bloom
author: E. T. Carter
description: A flower iris filling the frame: overlapping teardrop petal lobes whorl out of a dark central core in three offset, interleaving rings, the way a dahlia packs its bloom. Each petal has a luminous spine and a tapering tip; colour blends cyclically through the palette by angle while the whole bloom opens and closes on a slow breath, the core a dark protagonist with a glowing rim.

params.label: Petals
params.effect: Petals per whorl around the circle; fewer reads as a broad open flower, more as a tight packed rosette.

params.label: Curl
params.effect: How much each petal sweeps tangentially with radius; 0 gives straight radial petals, 1 a soft pinwheel spiral.

params.label: Breath speed
params.effect: Rate at which the bloom opens and closes; minimum is a near-minute breath, maximum a slow visible pulse.

params.label: Core size
params.effect: Mean radius of the dark central core around which the petals whorl and the breath dilates.
